title: On the fence
text: On the fence. Ordered this one along with a couple of plastic ones.  I actually like the plastic ones better.  The problem with this one is the assembly and the assembly instructions.  It will be great once I can get the drawers/holders in place.  I like the sturdiness of the shelves and they fit under one side of my kitchen sink.  Having two storage layers is great and really maximizes the use of the space.

product_metadata.title: LIDYUK Under Sink Organizer, 2-Tier Kitchen Cabinet Organizer with Sliding Storage Basket Drawers, for Bathroom, Kitchen, Office, Black
features: 2-TIER BASKET SPACE-SAVING: LIDYUK under sink cabinet organizer features double-tier design, maximizing vertical space and providing ample storage.

SLIDING DRAWER-TYPE DESIGN: Sliding drawer-type basket is convenient for you to pull out and use under the sink or in the cabinet, without having to move the entire item. Also it's designed with a stop mechanism to prevent the drawers from sliding all the way out.
REMOVABLE & FOLDABLE – For LIDYUK bathroom organizer under sink, the drawers are removable and foldable, you can use the baskets individually or fold it when not in use, save your space better.
LARGER CAPACITY - Measures 14" L x 10.8" W x 16" H assembled. Drawer: 13.85" L x 8.5" W x 3.9" H. It's 9.3" From the bottom of the lower drawer to the bottom of the upper drawer.

MULTI-FUNCTIONAL ORGANIZER – Can be used as a cleaning supplies organizer, spice rack, cabinet organizer, or under sink storage organizer, place it anywhere that you need additional storage. It fits great in the kitchen, cabinet, pantry, bathroom, office, workshop, and more.
